comment.narrative: Including: - 60.000 people reached through rehabilitation of SAEP - All distributions except shelter kit Les Anglais and distributions for IFRC as we are in the same sections with the rehabilitation of the SAEP systems. Distributions were per household, so I multiplied that by 5 (average household size in Haiti).

Including: - 60.000 people reached through rehabilitation of SAEP - All distributions except shelter kit Les Anglais and distributions for IFRC as we are in the same sections with the rehabilitation of the SAEP systems.

Indicators on project are per household, average of 5 persons per household. Not counted all the families who benefit from the SAEP systems rehabilitated, as this is presumed indirectly. From Q3 we can count the families around the water systems as well, as they will have received direct hygiene sensitisation as well.
